vsam.why: base/cntl/adef121.jcl DEFINE2: DATA(... KEYS(21 0) RECORDSIZE(64 64)); the engine's facts do not read KEYS / RECORDSIZE inside the DATA component, so the case states them

region.why: a deployment fact: LGIPVS01 ASSIGNs SYSID (unused afterwards); GenApp names no region in the corpus

scenarios.name: generic-key-on-file
scenarios.why: the operator types LGPF M0000000002: RECEIVE gives 16 bytes, 16 - 6 = 10 key digits; READ KSDSPOLY GENERIC KEYLENGTH(11) GTEQ on 'M0000000002' reads motor policy 1 of customer 2 (NORMAL, its type is the key's): SEND TEXT 'Policy Key=M00000000020000000001' LENGTH(80)

scenarios.name: generic-next-key
scenarios.why: no motor policy of customer 3: GTEQ reads the next key, M0000000005/0000000003 (NORMAL, still type M), and sends its key

scenarios.name: generic-other-type
scenarios.why: no endowment policy at or after customer 9: GTEQ reads the first house policy (H0000000004...), whose type is not the key's -> 'Policy Bad=' with 13 / 13 in the numbers

scenarios.name: generic-past-the-end
scenarios.why: no key at or after M0000000011: NOTFND -> 'Policy Bad=' with 13 / 13

scenarios.name: short-customer-number
scenarios.why: nine digits typed: 15 - 6 = 9, WS-COMMAREA(2:9) moved to PART-KEY-NUM PIC 9(10) (an alphanumeric sending item into a numeric DISPLAY one: right-aligned, a leading zero) -> commercial policy 10 of customer 1

notes: GenApp's VSAM policy key inquiry (LGIPVS01, transaction LGPF in the CSD: base/cntl/cdef121.jcl; a terminal transaction: no GenApp program LINKs it). It ASSIGNs SYSID, STARTCODE and INVOKINGPROG; a terminal task (STARTCODE 'TD', X19, INVOKINGPROG blank: the first program) RECEIVEs the operator's line (an unformatted RECEIVE: the scenario's terminal input), takes the policy type and the customer number after the transaction id, and EXEC CICS READ FILE('KSDSPOLY') INTO(CA-AREA) LENGTH(F64 = 64) RIDFLD(PART-KEY) KEYLENGTH(F11 = 11) GENERIC GTEQ: the first policy whose type + customer number is at or after the key's. A policy of the key's type sends 'Policy Key=' and its 21-byte key; another type, or NOTFND, 'Policy Bad=' with 13 in both numbers; SEND TEXT FROM(WRITE-MSG) LENGTH(80) ERASE WAIT FREEKB, then RETURN. Not exercised: the COMMAREA path (STARTCODE 'D...' -- a DPL, which the stub's ASSIGN STARTCODE does not state -- or a LINK from another program, which no GenApp program makes): the key then comes from DFHCOMMAREA and the answer goes back into it. Data: ksdspoly.txt is the genapp-lgupdb01 case's ten GenApp sample policies.
